title: SvgTextPath
responsibility: Renders the native textPath element without extra wrapper DOM or feature behavior.

inputs.name: SvgTextPath.attributes
inputs.description: Native textPath attributes and event handlers. The native atom call preserves Svelte bindings, actions and scoped styles.

inputs.name: SvgTextPath.children
inputs.description: Optional content within the native textPath element; native HTML content rules still apply.

outputs.name: SvgTextPath
outputs.description: The actual native textPath element, with forwarded attributes and content and no additional wrapper.
